tools.name: search_breeds
tools.description: Use when someone is choosing a dog breed or asks which breeds are healthy, e.g. 'healthiest small dog breeds' or 'welche Rasse passt zu mir'. Searches HonestDog's breed catalogue by name (German or English, umlauts optional), size class, or S–E breeding-health grade, most popular first. Returns bree
